newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's Brahma launches Level One ADRs.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's Brahma launches Level One ADRs.

text.p: Brazilian brewery Companhia Cervejaria Brahma said it has launched a program of Level One American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
"As of this date, the program of Level One American Depositary Receipts will begin," the firm said in a statement published in local newspapers.
The Brahma ADRs will be backed by existing common shares and allow the company to be traded in the U.S. over-the-counter market.

Each ADR will represent 20 common shares, and The Bank of New York will be coordinating the operation in the U.S., the statement said. Brazilian private bank Itau will br the custodian bank in Brazil, it said.
In August, Brahma launched Level One ADRs backed by preferred shares.
